The tracking is accurate but the distance estimates are way out!. I like Moves Lite as it knows where I’ve been and for the most part correctly attributes my journeys to the correct form of travel. In addition it is not too heavy a drain on the battery. 

The negatives are that the distance estimates are way out. So for example, a bike ride from Hammersmith to Harrow on the Hill appears on the map mostly as a bike ride, although the downhill stretches are sometimes misattributed as a “car ride”, but the distance estimated for the return trip is 6.6Km. The real distance is more like 30Km. 

If the app can accurately track the trip on a map, I would have thought it could estimate the distance travelled more accurately too.

I really enjoy this app, however I think there need to be a few tweaks and improvements.

• locations need to be updated in the home screen - I can be in a location for a while, but the only one that comes up is home at the start of the day, and then driving / walking. The map shows where I have been, but the main screen does not. 
• the map shows random places that I have stopped, such as stop lights. This can also happen on the home screen with no way to remove it from that screen.
• the map makes multiple location checkpoints for certain places such as stores and schools. There are no ways to combine the checkpoints. 
• there is no way to manually add the location checkpoints into the home screen so it shows up on your daily activities and routes.
• a colour wheel would be fantastic for choosing colours. Also, adding a shopping bag, school and some additional icons would be useful.
• other than writing a review, there is no information on how to contact the developer. This needs to be added. 
• an account would be helpful and the ability to export data, or an automatic export by email monthly would be helpful in case this app ever shuts down like Moves did.
• app should be able to connect to health data, Apple Watch and fitbit applications/devices 
• calories burned could potentially be a good add in option for users with heart rate monitor devices such as fitbits, connecting/syncing with Moves Lite.

I hope to see some of these updates in the near future, and hope to be able to receive contact info for the developer. If I can help out with further suggestions for improvement, I would have no problem with that.
